data.name: Manzoor
data.gender_notes: Manzoor is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who is able to manage and handle situations. The name Manzoor carries the meaning “Capable, Able” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Pashto. Parents who choose Manzoor usually hope their child will grow to embody capable, able and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of God's grace and ability to overcome challenges
data.etymology: Manzoor belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Capable, Able.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Manzoor total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

In the Islamic context, it exemplifies the trait of being in control of one's circumstances and making the best out of any situation. This quality is highly valued in various aspects of life, including personal and professional endeavors.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Manzoor reflects the belief in God's divine plan and one's ability to align with it. The name serves as a reminder to constant seeker of knowledge and wisdom that, with God's guidance, one can triumph over challenges and find success in life. The spiritual significance of Manzoor further highlights the importance of patience, trust, and perseverance in the journey towards personal growth and fulfillment.
